text:
sec-bot: Automated scan detected 27 OAuth client secrets (3 providers) that have not been rotated in >180 days. High-confidence. Please review and action. https://redwood.internal/tools/sec-scan#1929999999

alex: Yikes — thanks for the heads up. Where are these clients located (GCP/AWS/Azure)?

sec-bot: Breakdown: 12 GCP OAuth clients, 8 Azure AD app secrets, 7 AWS Cognito clients. Attached detection snapshot: oauth_stale_report_1929999999.csv (internal).

priya: Can we get an owner mapping? we need to route to teams asap.

alex: I pulled owners for GCP ones — most are service teams: ing-service(4), embed-team(3), portal(3), unattended-infra(2). I'll post owners shortly.

sec-bot: Owners extracted from identity metadata where available. Missing owner fields for 5 clients.

priya: Proposed plan: 1) Owners ack within 24h. 2) Rotate secrets for any in use within 7 days. 3) Disable unused clients older than 90 days after confirmation. 4) Enforce OIDC / short-lived creds for new clients.

alex: +1 on timeline. For rotation steps see runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oauth-cleanup 
Example GCP rotate command (service account key):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=sa-infra@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# update secret manager and deployments, then delete old key
```

priya: For Azure: use az ad app credential reset and update Key Vault references. For AWS Cognito we need to re-issue client secrets in the console or via AWS CLI.

dana: Quick Q — any customer-facing tokens affected? we checked the list and nothing tagged production-external, but portal has integrations with a partner. I'll do a safe windowed rotation with the partner tomorrow. @ops-oncall can you hold a brief maintenance window if needed?

ops-oncall: Can do. Block a 60m window between 02:00–06:00 UTC. Ping me when schedule is set.

security-leads: Action items for security: 1) enforce rotation policy (90d) in the IAM policy engine; 2) add linter to CI to prevent checked-in client secrets; 3) create alert for >120d stale clients. We'll draft a short policy update and share.

priya: I'm adding a temporary org-wide rule: all clients without owner metadata will be disabled in 72h unless claimed. Owners, please claim by commenting in this thread and update the internal owner field: https://redwood.internal/identity/clients.

alex: Claimed — ing-service will own 3 GCP clients and 1 Azure app. I'll update the inventory now.

dana: portal team claims 2 GCP and the partner-facing AWS client. We'll coordinate with partner for key rollover.

sec-bot: Reminder set — owners who don't ack by 24h will get reminder @channel. Automated temp disable scheduled: 1930070000 (approx).

priya: Security will open a consolidated ticket and assign per-team subtasks. Ticket: SEC-2026-047 (link: https://redwood.internal/pm/SEC-2026-047). Please add PR/rollback notes to the ticket when you rotate.

alex: For teams that need help automating rotation, SRE has a small helper script and examples. gist: https://redwood.internal/gists/oauth-rotate-scripts 

ops-oncall: Noted. For any rollbacks, ensure feature flags are ready to flip. If partner integrations break, call me directly.

priya: Final ask — update your service runbooks with new secret rotation steps and owner contact. We'll follow up with an org-wide policy doc and enforcement timeline next week.

dana: Ack + starting partner coordination now.

alex: Acknowledged. ing-service will rotate and update SEC-2026-047 by EOD +7d.

priya: Thanks everyone. If anyone sees unexpected failures after rotation, file an incident in #incidents and tag @security-leads. :lock:
